value.text: Got the link. Preschool Sports and Games for Maya, Wednesdays at 10:30 AM, $280.60 for residents or $290.60 for non-residents (course code 00028147). Her age fits the 3 to 5 band. Residents can register Sep 8, and the public opens Tuesday, September 15 at 10:30 a.m. I had Monday, September 14 for that date, but the page says the 15th, so I'm going by the page. This one also has a registration form you can't fill out through me, so leave a few minutes for it.
